versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "guaikei-xhs-detail-for-insight" skill.
- Automatically routes Xiaohongshu links to fetch note details, comments, or user posts based on link type.
- Supports structured JSON output for searches, single note details, comment analysis, or creator content monitoring.
- Only processes public Xiaohongshu data; no login or interaction features included.
- Requires configuration of GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access.
- Includes practical usage examples and clear rules for correct input and error handling.
